_comment: New file — the project had none. Only 'headers' and 'functions' are set.
No 'routes', 'rewrites', 'cleanUrls' or 'trailingSlash' keys: adding any of
those changes behaviour for the five existing tools, which is the one thing
this file must not do. Every header block below is path-scoped to /ai-notes/
maxDuration of 300s needs a Pro plan. On Hobby it silently caps at 60s and a
long recording will fail at the transcription step. Check the plan before

headers.value: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; font-src 'self'; connect-src 'self'; media-src 'self' blob:; worker-src 'self'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'
